title: Let remembrance soften the walk
summary: Here sweetness of speech is the fruit of sangat, one-pointed Naam, and humility in the body. Let remembrance reach the tone, the pace, and the way you enter the room.
takeaway: Let Naam reach the tone, the pace, and the way you enter the room.
lifeApplication: Before answering, lower the speed of the body first; let the next words come from the peace you are willing to walk in.

source.shortMeaning: Sweet speech and humble walking arise when Naam is kept in the heart through sangat.
source.lifeApplication: Slow the body before answering so remembrance can shape both tone and posture.

evidence.coreClaim: Sweet speech and humble walking arise when Naam is kept in the heart through sangat.
evidence.turn: The shabad moves from performative religion to embodied peace: the mouth sweetens because the heart is held by Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before answering, lower the speed of the body first; let the next words come from the peace you are willing to walk in.
